_comment_model_repo: HuggingFace repo ID for the VADAR model. Default: OpenYourMind/gemma-4-12B-it-abliterated-uncensored
_comment_context_length: How many tokens the model can see at once. Gemma 4 12B supports up to 262144 (256K). Lower = less VRAM/RAM. Min: 4096, Max: 262144
_comment_sliding_window_threshold: Sliding window target. When total tokens reach 100% of context_length, oldest non-system messages are dropped until total drops to this % of context_length. Min: 50, Max: 99
_comment_sliding_window_delete: Deprecated — derived from sliding_window_threshold_percent (drop_ratio = 100 - threshold). Kept for backwards compat. Min: 1, Max: 50
_comment_memory_cap: Maximum % of context that memory content can occupy. Min: 1, Max: 50
_comment_global_context_cap: Maximum % of context that global (cross-session) context can occupy. Min: 1, Max: 50
_comment_temperature: Generation temperature. Higher = more creative/random. Min: 0.1, Max: 2.0
_comment_top_p: Nucleus sampling: only sample from tokens with cumulative probability <= top_p. Min: 0.1, Max: 1.0
_comment_top_k: Only sample from the top K tokens at each step. Min: 1, Max: 1000
_comment_max_new_tokens: Maximum new tokens to generate per inference. Min: 64, Max: 32768
_comment_stream: Stream output tokens to terminal in real-time. true or false
_comment_ping_time: Seconds of silence before VADAR gets pinged in interactive mode. 0 = disabled. 1-4 = reset to 15. Min: 0, Max: 3600
_comment_summarize_threshold: Act output longer than this many characters gets summarized by the Summarizer brother. Min: 100, Max: 50000
_comment_read_preview_lines: How many lines to show when read is called without a line range. Min: 10, Max: 500
_comment_listen_max_segment: Maximum seconds for a listen/watch segment. Min: 5, Max: 300
_comment_listen_auto_threshold: Audio shorter than this (seconds) can be listened to without specifying a range. Min: 5, Max: 120
_comment_catcher_max_retries: How many times Catcher retries a failed tool call before giving up. Min: 1, Max: 10
_comment_lite_gpu_layers: VADAR Lite (GGUF): GPU layers to offload. -1 = all, 0 = CPU only. Min: -1, Max: 999
_comment_lite_n_threads: VADAR Lite (GGUF): CPU threads. -1 = auto-detect. Min: -1, Max: 256
_comment_lite_repeat_penalty: VADAR Lite (GGUF): repeat penalty for generation. Min: 1.0, Max: 2.0
_comment_lite_verbose: VADAR Lite (GGUF): verbose llama.cpp output. true or false
